issues.title: Walker-Saturation Context Gap
issues.why: The auditor walker byte-cap (120KB) excludes 13 leaf files (02-13) containing the actual component logic for Sidebar, Buttons, and Typography.
issues.fix: The spec already includes a 'Structural Pin' (AC-039) to acknowledge this; implementers must rely on the detailed GWT criteria in §97 which act as the normative proxy for the missing files.

issues.title: Missing Concurrency/Race Condition Handling in Theme Toggle
issues.why: While FOUC is addressed via a head script, the interaction between the system 'prefers-color-scheme' listener and the manual toggle state is not explicitly defined for edge cases (e.g., OS theme change while app is open).
issues.fix: Add a requirement to AC-005 for a window.matchMedia listener that updates the theme only if no localStorage override exists.

issues.title: Ambiguous 'Primary-Glow' Token Usage
issues.why: The --primary-glow token is defined in §00 but its specific HSL derivation logic (relative to --primary) is not pinned, leading to potential inconsistency if re-themed manually.
issues.fix: Explicitly state in §00 that --primary-glow should maintain a +15% lightness offset from --primary unless otherwise specified.
